messages:
eva: Hey @eng-ml — customer MedCom is asking to onboard Lattice-21B-med for clinical summarization. Constraints: PHI, private deployment likely, deterministic evals required, target p95 token latency ~200ms for 512 context, cost sensitivity. Need triage + owner + quick bring-up checklist.

nate: I'll take ownership. Quick clarifying q: do they require full FP16 or can we target 4-bit quant (q4_1/q4_0)?

maya: They prefer minimized PHI exposure and KMS integration. Private control plane + audit logs needed. Happy to coordinate compliance.

jules: Private deploy is fine. Runtime notes: Lattice-21B FP16 ~16GB VRAM. With q4_1 we can fit on 2xA10/1xA100-slice (depends on kernels). We'll need a quant smoke + determinism test.

nate: Proposed short plan:
- run quant sweep: q8_0, q4_0, q4_1 (compare logits/dev loss)
- perf profile at seq=512 and 1024 (p50/p95/p99)
- evaluation: MedQA + customer-supplied testset for hallucination/regression
- compare against redwood-base-21b on same prompt set

quant-bot: Ticket created: #ML-4127 — quant sweep pipeline started. Uploads will appear under /evals/ML-4127.

eva: Adding checklist items for gating:
- privacy sign-off (PO + compliance)
- KMS key + audit logs enabled
- E2E eval pass criteria: ExactMatch >= 78% on sample, hallucination rate < 2% on spot checks
- Fallback policy: Redwood-7B-med auto-fallback
- Canary rollout: 1% traffic with strict SLO monitoring

nate: Quick config I'll iterate from for staging (putting here so infra can pre-seed):
```yaml
quant:
  method: q4_1
  per_channel: true
  act_order: false
batching:
  max_batch: 8
  timeout_ms: 25
cache:
  prefix_kv: true
```

maya: For release gating also require: token-level cost dashboard, latency SLO alert at p95>350ms, and an automated rollback hook if regression > 5% vs baseline.

tom: SRE notes: have a presign failover plan — if private capacity exhausted fallback to Dedicated with TLS + encrypted egress. Also we should add a health-check route that validates prefix-KV correctness each deploy.

jules: I'll kick off a staging bring-up tomorrow morning and run the quant smoke. ETA 48h for initial sweep + perf numbers. I'll tag @nate and @eva with results.

eva: Thanks — marking priority: high for this quarter. Please keep updates concise in this thread.

deploy-bot: Trigger received — provisioning staging cluster: cluster/staging-lattice21b-177444. Logs: https://ci.internal/runs/177444 (will post cluster status).

nate: Prep note: uploading eval corpora to /data/med-lattice/testset_v2 now. Will seed eval job after staging is up.

maya: :thumbsup:

[thread status: owner=nate, ticket=#ML-4127, priority=high]
